organization.short_description:
Financial Technology Partners (FT Partners) is a global investment banking firm dedicated exclusively to the financial technology (FinTech) sector. Headquartered in San Francisco, with additional offices in New York, Miami, and London, FT Partners provides strategic and financial advisory services to FinTech CEOs, founders, and investors. Founded in 2001 by Steve McLaughlin, the firm has built a reputation for its specialized approach to mission-critical transactions.

FT Partners offers a range of advisory services, including mergers and acquisitions, private capital raising, IPO guidance, debt advisory, and valuation services. The firm has been recognized for its achievements, earning titles such as "Dealmaker of the Year" and "Investment Banking Firm of the Year" from The M&A Advisor. With a focus on the integration of technology and financial services, FT Partners serves clients across various categories, including payments, investment services, and technology solutions.
